definitions.explanation: Humble form of {訪|たず}ねる/{訪問|ほうもん}する.
Humble form of {聞|き}く/{質問|しつもん}する.
Humble form of {聞|き}く (to hear information).

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}お{宅|たく}に{伺|うかが}います。
examples.english: I will visit your home tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}3{時|じ}にオフィスに{伺|うかが}ってもよろしいですか。
examples.english: May I come to your office at 3 PM?

examples.japanese: ご{都合|つごう}のよい{日|ひ}を{伺|うかが}ってもいいですか。
examples.english: May I ask when would be convenient for you?

examples.japanese: お{名前|なまえ}を{伺|うかが}ってもよろしいでしょうか。
ご{意見|いけん}を{伺|うかが}いたいのですが。
examples.english: I would like to hear your opinion.

examples.japanese: お{話|はなし}は{部長|ぶちょう}から{伺|うかが}っております。
examples.english: I have heard about it from the department manager.

notes:
Humble verb ({謙譲語|けんじょうご}). Used to speak politely about one's own actions when addressing someone of higher status.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{宅|たく}に{伺|うかが}う: to visit someone's home
- ご{意見|いけん}を{伺|うかが}う: to ask for one's opinion
